-- Medidas oficiais do mapa REFUGIO (usadas por todas as partes da Etapa 3). Norte = -Z
-- v3: mapa 2400x2400 studs, biomas (Neve, Deserto, Vulcao, Pantano), 3 rios, 5 lagos, ~80 picos, 3 trilhas.
local MapConfig = {}
MapConfig.Version = 3

MapConfig.Seed = 7341
MapConfig.Voxel = 4
MapConfig.Bounds = { MinX = -1200, MaxX = 1200, MinZ = -1800, MaxZ = 600, MinY = -16, MaxY = 220 }

-- Macicos: { X, Z, Raio, Altura }. Os 9 primeiros sao manuais; o resto e gerado (mesma seed = mesmo mapa).
MapConfig.Peaks = {
    { -150, -230, 45, 38 }, { 130, -380, 50, 45 }, { -190, -400, 55, 50 },
    { 85, -205, 38, 28 },   { -90, -335, 35, 30 }, { 70, -475, 40, 36 },
    { -200, 150, 50, 22 },  { 235, 175, 45, 20 },  { -60, 260, 55, 16 },
}

local function segd(px, pz, a, b)
    local abx, abz = b.X - a.X, b.Y - a.Y
    local t = ((px - a.X) * abx + (pz - a.Y) * abz) / (abx * abx + abz * abz)
    t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
    local dx, dz = px - (a.X + abx * t), pz - (a.Y + abz * t)
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
end

do
    local rng = Random.new(MapConfig.Seed + 5)
    local B, list = MapConfig.Bounds, MapConfig.Peaks
    local vc, sp, mt, cl, vo = MapConfig.Village.Center, MapConfig.Spawn, MapConfig.Mountain.Center, MapConfig.ClearingCenter, MapConfig.Volcano
    local target, tries = #list + 70, 0
    while #list < target and tries < 3000 do
        tries = tries + 1
        local x = rng:NextNumber(B.MinX + 140, B.MaxX - 140)
        local z = rng:NextNumber(B.MinZ + 140, B.MaxZ - 140)
        local roll = rng:NextNumber()
        local r, h
        if roll < 0.55 then
            r, h = rng:NextNumber(30, 55), rng:NextNumber(14, 32)
        elseif roll < 0.88 then
            r, h = rng:NextNumber(60, 95), rng:NextNumber(35, 65)
        else
            r, h = rng:NextNumber(110, 160), rng:NextNumber(70, 110)
        end
        local ok = true
        local function dist(ax, az) return math.sqrt((x - ax) ^ 2 + (z - az) ^ 2) end
        if dist(vc.X, vc.Y) < 380 + r * 0.5 then ok = false end
        if ok and dist(sp.X, sp.Y) < 230 + r * 0.5 then ok = false end
        if ok and dist(mt.X, mt.Y) < 270 + r * 0.5 then ok = false end
        if ok and dist(cl.X, cl.Y) < 160 + r then ok = false end
        if ok and dist(vo.X, vo.Z) < vo.R + r then ok = false end
        if ok then
            for _, lk in ipairs(MapConfig.Lakes) do
                if dist(lk[1], lk[2]) < lk[3] * 1.6 + r * 0.6 then ok = false break end
            end
        end
        if ok then
            for _, rv in ipairs(MapConfig.Rivers) do
                local rx = rv.X + rv.Amp * math.sin(z * rv.Freq + (rv.Phase or 0))
                if math.abs(x - rx) < r * 0.9 + 30 then ok = false break end
            end
        end
        if ok then
            for _, pts in pairs(MapConfig.Trails) do
                for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
                    if segd(x, z, pts[i], pts[i + 1]) < r * 0.8 + 25 then ok = false break end
                end
                if not ok then break end
            end
        end
        if ok then
            for _, pk in ipairs(list) do
                if dist(pk[1], pk[2]) < (r + pk[3]) * 0.55 then ok = false break end
            end
        end
        if ok then table.insert(list, { math.floor(x), math.floor(z), math.floor(r), math.floor(h) }) end
    end
end

MapConfig.Zones = {

    { Name = "Zone_Swamp",       Center = Vector2.new(-760, 230),   Size = Vector2.new(860, 860),   Type = "Wild", Oruk = false, Risk = 2, Priority = 3 },

files.changes: Gera biomas (neve, deserto, vulcao, pantano), lagos, 3 rios, vulcao com cratera e picos em 3 tamanhos. Mais rapido (trilhas pre-calculadas). Version 3.
files.content:
local C = require(script.Parent.MapConfig)
local TerrainGen = {}
TerrainGen.Version = 3

local B, V, M = C.Bounds, C.Voxel, Enum.Material
local SEED = C.Seed * 0.001
local WL = C.River.WaterLevel

local function smooth(t)
    t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

local function lerp(a, b, t)
    return a + (b - a) * t
end

local function villageDist(x, z)
    local v = C.Village
    return math.max(math.sqrt((x - v.Center.X) ^ 2 + (z - v.Center.Y) ^ 2) - v.Radius, 0)
end

function TerrainGen.RiverX(z, r)
    r = r or C.River
    return r.X + r.Amp * math.sin(z * r.Freq + (r.Phase or 0))
end

local function nearestRiver(x, z)
    local best, br = math.huge, C.River
    for _, r in ipairs(C.Rivers) do
        local d = math.abs(x - TerrainGen.RiverX(z, r))
        if d < best then best, br = d, r end
    end
    return best, br
end

-- trilhas pre-calculadas em numeros (sem criar Vector2 a cada ponto do mapa)
local SEGS, TMINX, TMAXX, TMINZ, TMAXZ = {}, math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
for _, pts in pairs(C.Trails) do
    for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
        local a, b = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
        local dx, dz = b.X - a.X, b.Y - a.Y
        table.insert(SEGS, { a.X, a.Y, dx, dz, dx * dx + dz * dz })
        TMINX = math.min(TMINX, a.X, b.X) TMAXX = math.max(TMAXX, a.X, b.X)
        TMINZ = math.min(TMINZ, a.Y, b.Y) TMAXZ = math.max(TMAXZ, a.Y, b.Y)
    end
end

function TerrainGen.TrailDistance(x, z)
    if x < TMINX - 80 or x > TMAXX + 80 or z < TMINZ - 80 or z > TMAXZ + 80 then return 999 end
    local best = math.huge
    for _, s in ipairs(SEGS) do
        local t = math.clamp(((x - s[1]) * s[3] + (z - s[2]) * s[4]) / s[5], 0, 1)
        local ex, ez = x - (s[1] + s[3] * t), z - (s[2] + s[4] * t)
        local d = math.sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez)
        if d < best then best = d end
    end
    return best
end

-- Biomas: pesos 0..1 (tabela reutilizada: leia os valores logo apos chamar)
local W = { top = "", topw = 0 }
local lastX, lastZ = nil, nil
local function biome(x, z)
    if x == lastX and z == lastZ then return W end
    lastX, lastZ = x, z
    local warp = math.noise(x / 260, z / 260, SEED + 70) * 90
    W.top, W.topw = "", 0
    for _, b in ipairs(C.Biomes) do
        local dx, dz = x - b.X, z - b.Z
        local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) + warp
        local w = smooth((1 - d / b.R) * 1.6)
        W[b.Name] = w
        if w > W.topw then W.top, W.topw = b.Name, w end
    end
    return W
end

function TerrainGen.BiomeAt(x, z)
    local w = biome(x, z)
    if w.topw > 0.5 then return w.top end
    return "Forest"
end

function TerrainGen.InAncient(x, z)
    for _, a in ipairs(C.AncientForest) do
        local dx, dz = x - a[1], z - a[2]
        if dx * dx + dz * dz < a[3] * a[3] then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- picos: altura ajustada ao bioma (neve mais alto, deserto/pantano mais baixo)
local PEAKMULT = { Snow = 1.5, Volcanic = 1.15, Desert = 0.45, Swamp = 0.35 }
local PEAKS = {}
for _, pk in ipairs(C.Peaks) do
    local w = biome(pk[1], pk[2])
    local m = 1
    if w.topw > 0.4 then m = PEAKMULT[w.top] or 1 end
    table.insert(PEAKS, { pk[1], pk[2], pk[3], pk[4] * m })
end
lastX, lastZ = nil, nil

function TerrainGen.Height(x, z)
    local wild = smooth(villageDist(x, z) / C.Village.Blend)
    local w = biome(x, z)
    local wSw, wSn, wDe, wVo = w.Swamp or 0, w.Snow or 0, w.Desert or 0, w.Volcanic or 0

    local n = math.noise(x / 130, z / 130, SEED) * 22
        + math.noise(x / 45, z / 45, SEED + 10) * 6
        + math.noise(x / 14, z / 14, SEED + 20) * 1.2
    n = n * (1 - 0.8 * wSw) * (1 - 0.35 * wDe)
    local h = C.BaseHeight + wild * (4 + n)

    -- relevo extra: cordilheiras ao norte + relevo de cada bioma
    local extra = 0
    local north = smooth((-z - 130) / 140)
    local ridge = math.max(1 - math.abs(math.noise(x / 150, z / 150, SEED + 50)) * 2, 0)
    extra = extra + north * 34 * ridge * ridge
    if wSn > 0 then
        local r2 = math.max(1 - math.abs(math.noise(x / 170, z / 170, SEED + 80)) * 2, 0)
        extra = extra + wSn * (14 + 78 * r2 * r2 + math.noise(x / 40, z / 40, SEED + 81) * 6)
    end
    if wDe > 0 then -- mesas (plato com paredes) e dunas
        local t = math.noise(x / 150, z / 150, SEED + 90)
        extra = extra + wDe * (36 * smooth((t - 0.02) / 0.1) - 4 + math.noise(x / 38, z / 38, SEED + 91) * 3)
    end
    if wVo > 0 then
        extra = extra + wVo * (10 + math.abs(math.noise(x / 55, z / 55, SEED + 92)) * 40)
    end

    -- suaviza perto de trilha, rio e Clareira (para continuar andavel)
    local td = TerrainGen.TrailDistance(x, z)
    local dr = nearestRiver(x, z)
    local cdx, cdz = x - C.ClearingCenter.X, z - C.ClearingCenter.Y
    local f = 0.3 + 0.7 * smooth((td - 4) / 24)
    f = f * (0.4 + 0.6 * smooth((dr - 20) / 40))
    f = f * (0.2 + 0.8 * smooth((math.sqrt(cdx * cdx + cdz * cdz) - 70) / 40))
    h = h + extra * f * wild

    local e = math.min(x - B.MinX, B.MaxX - x, z - B.MinZ, B.MaxZ - z)
    h = h + C.Edge.Height * smooth(1 - e / C.Edge.Width) * (0.8 + 0.2 * math.noise(x / 30, z / 30, SEED + 30))

    local m = C.Mountain
    local dm = math.sqrt((x - m.Center.X) ^ 2 + (z - m.Center.Y) ^ 2)
    h = h + m.Height * math.exp(-(dm / m.Radius) ^ 2)

    -- picos (somados UMA vez; livres perto da trilha)
    local clear = smooth(td / C.PeakTrailClear)
    for _, pk in ipairs(PEAKS) do
        local dx = x - pk[1]
        if math.abs(dx) < pk[3] * 2.6 then
            local dz = z - pk[2]
            if math.abs(dz) < pk[3] * 2.6 then
                local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                local shape = 0.8 + 0.4 * math.noise(x / 22, z / 22, SEED + 50)
                h = h + pk[4] * shape * math.exp(-(d / pk[3]) ^ 2) * wild * clear
            end
        end
    end

    local vo = C.Volcano
    if vo then
        local d = math.sqrt((x - vo.X) ^ 2 + (z - vo.Z) ^ 2)
        if d < vo.R then
            local cr = vo.Crater * vo.R
            local cone
            if d < cr then
                cone = vo.H * (1 - vo.Crater) ^ 1.5 - 30 * (1 - d / cr)
            else
                cone = vo.H * (1 - d / vo.R) ^ 1.5
            end
            h = h + cone * (0.92 + 0.08 * math.noise(x / 20, z / 20, SEED + 99))
        end
    end

    if td < C.TrailWidth then
        h = h - 0.8 * (1 - td / C.TrailWidth)
    end

    if wSw > 0 then h = lerp(h, WL + 2.4, 0.85 * wSw) end -- pantano: baixo e plano
    h = math.max(h, WL + 1.5)
    if wSw > 0.25 then -- poças do pantano
        local pn = math.noise(x / 36, z / 36, SEED + 95)
        if pn > 0.22 then h = lerp(h, WL - 2.5, smooth((pn - 0.22) / 0.12) * wSw) end
    end

    for _, lk in ipairs(C.Lakes) do
        local lx = x - lk[1]
        if math.abs(lx) < lk[3] * 1.6 then
            local lz = z - lk[2]
            local d = math.sqrt(lx * lx + lz * lz)
            if d < lk[3] * 1.6 then
                h = lerp(WL - lk[4], h, smooth((d - lk[3] * 0.7) / (lk[3] * 0.9)))
            end
        end
    end

    for _, R in ipairs(C.Rivers) do
        local d = math.abs(x - TerrainGen.RiverX(z, R))
        if d < R.Width + R.Bank then
            h = lerp(R.WaterLevel - R.Depth, h, smooth((d - R.Width * 0.5) / (R.Width * 0.5 + R.Bank)))
        end
    end
    return math.min(h, B.MaxY - 8)
end

local function surfaceMaterial(x, z, h, slope)
    local dr, rv = nearestRiver(x, z)
    if dr < rv.Width + 3 and h < rv.WaterLevel + 2 then return M.Sand end
    if TerrainGen.TrailDistance(x, z) < C.TrailWidth then return M.Mud end
    local w = biome(x, z)
    local top, tw = w.top, w.topw
    if tw > 0.5 then
        if top == "Snow" then
            if slope > 1.1 then return M.Rock end
            return M.Snow
        elseif top == "Desert" then
            if slope > 0.9 then return M.Sandstone end
            return M.Sand
        elseif top == "Volcanic" then
            if slope > 1.4 then return M.Slate end
            if math.noise(x / 18, z / 18, SEED + 97) > 0.45 then return M.CrackedLava end
            return M.Basalt
        elseif top == "Swamp" then
            if math.noise(x / 30, z / 30, SEED + 96) > 0.3 then return M.Mud end
            return M.LeafyGrass
        end
    end
    if slope > 1 or h > C.BaseHeight + 55 then return M.Rock end
    if villageDist(x, z) <= 0 then return M.Grass end
    if math.noise(x / 25, z / 25, SEED + 40) > 0.15 then return M.LeafyGrass end
    return M.Grass
end

function TerrainGen.Build()
    local terrain = workspace.Terrain
    local nx, nz, ny = (B.MaxX - B.MinX) // V, (B.MaxZ - B.MinZ) // V, (B.MaxY - B.MinY) // V
    local H = {}
    for i = 0, nx + 1 do
        local row = {}
        for k = 0, nz + 1 do
            row[k] = TerrainGen.Height(B.MinX + (i - 0.5) * V, B.MinZ + (k - 0.5) * V)
        end
        H[i] = row
        if i % 10 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    print("[MapGen] Alturas calculadas (" .. nx .. "x" .. nz .. " colunas)")

    local CH, water = 32, WL
    local done, total = 0, math.ceil(nx / CH) * math.ceil(nz / CH)
    for i0 = 1, nx, CH do
        for k0 = 1, nz, CH do
            local cx, cz = math.min(CH, nx - i0 + 1), math.min(CH, nz - k0 + 1)
            local mats, occs = table.create(cx), table.create(cx)
            for a = 1, cx do
                local i = i0 + a - 1
                local mA, oA = table.create(ny), table.create(ny)
                for j = 1, ny do
                    mA[j], oA[j] = table.create(cz), table.create(cz)
                end
                for b = 1, cz do
                    local k = k0 + b - 1
                    local h = H[i][k]
                    local slope = (math.abs(H[i + 1][k] - H[i - 1][k]) + math.abs(H[i][k + 1] - H[i][k - 1])) / (2 * V)
                    local top = surfaceMaterial(B.MinX + (i - 0.5) * V, B.MinZ + (k - 0.5) * V, h, slope)
                    for j = 1, ny do
                        local y0 = B.MinY + (j - 1) * V
                        local depth = h - y0
                        local occ = math.clamp(depth / V, 0, 1)
                        local mat = M.Air
                        if occ > 0 then
                            if depth <= V * 2 then mat = top elseif depth > 16 then mat = M.Rock else mat = M.Ground end
                        elseif y0 < water then
                            mat, occ = M.Water, 1
                        end
                        mA[j][b], oA[j][b] = mat, occ
                    end
                end
                mats[a], occs[a] = mA, oA
            end
            local min = Vector3.new(B.MinX + (i0 - 1) * V, B.MinY, B.MinZ + (k0 - 1) * V)
            terrain:WriteVoxels(Region3.new(min, min + Vector3.new(cx * V, ny * V, cz * V)), V, mats, occs)
            done = done + 1
            if done % 40 == 0 then
                print(("[MapGen] Terreno %d/%d"):format(done, total))
                task.wait()
            end
        end
    end
end

return TerrainGen

local function effect(className)

end

local function invisiblePart(parent, name, size, cf)

    if old then old:Destroy() end
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name, p.Size, p.CFrame = name, size, cf
    p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false

    Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.6

        p:SetAttribute("ZoneType", z.Type)
        p:SetAttribute("OrukAllowed", z.Oruk)
        p:SetAttribute("Risk", z.Risk)
        p:SetAttribute("Priority", z.Priority)
        p:SetAttribute("Locked", z.Locked == true)
    end

local function buildMarkers(folder)

    end
    mark("Marker_Plaza", 0, 0)
    mark("Marker_VillageGate", 0, -150)
    mark("Marker_CaveEntrance", C.Cave.Entrance.X, C.Cave.Entrance.Y)
    mark("Marker_BridgeSite", TerrainGen.RiverX(C.BridgeZ), C.BridgeZ, C.River.WaterLevel + 3)
end

local function buildSpawns(folder)

        local old = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local s = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
        s.Name, s.Size = name, Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
        s.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, TerrainGen.Height(x, z) + 0.5, z)
        s.Anchored, s.CanCollide, s.CanQuery, s.CastShadow = true, false, false, false
        s.Transparency, s.Neutral, s.Duration, s.Enabled = 1, true, 0, enabled
        s.Parent = folder
    end
    spawn("Spawn_ForestEdge", C.Spawn.X, C.Spawn.Y, true)
    spawn("Spawn_Plaza", 0, 14, false)
end

function BuildBase.Run(opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local t0 = os.clock()
    local map = ensure(workspace, "Folder", "Map")
    for _, n in { "Village", "Forest", "Cave", "Decor", "Markers" } do
        ensure(map, "Folder", n)
    end
    local zones, spawns = ensure(workspace, "Folder", "Zones"), ensure(workspace, "Folder", "Spawns")
    ensure(workspace, "Folder", "Plots")
    ensure(workspace, "Folder", "Stalls")

    setupLighting()
    setupTerrainLook()
    if opts.terrain ~= false then
        workspace.Terrain:Clear() -- limpa o terreno antigo: nada de relevo velho misturado com o novo
        TerrainGen.Build()
    end
    buildZones(zones)
    buildMarkers(map.Markers)
    buildSpawns(spawns)

    pcall(function() game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService"):SetWaypoint("MapGen Base") end)
    print(("[MapGen] Base pronta em %.1fs"):format(os.clock() - t0))
end

return BuildBase

-- BuildNature.luau (ModuleScript em ServerStorage/MapGen)  -- v3

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local MapConfig = require(script.Parent.MapConfig)
local TG = require(script.Parent.TerrainGen)

local M = {}
M.Version = 3

local CFG = {
	Seed = 7421,
	GateAngles = { 270 },   -- 270 = lado -Z (portao da trilha, igual a VillageBuilder)
	ForestGrid = 28,
	DetailGrid = 20,
	MaxTrees = 4500,
	MaxDetails = 3500,
	MaxBridges = 8,
	GiantChance = 0.03,       -- floresta comum
	AncientGiantChance = 0.32, -- Floresta Antiga
	TallChance = 0.20,
}

local BLOCK = {}
for _, m in ipairs({
	Enum.Material.Water, Enum.Material.Mud, Enum.Material.Ground, Enum.Material.Rock,
	Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Enum.Material.Pavement, Enum.Material.Asphalt, Enum.Material.Concrete,
	Enum.Material.Salt, Enum.Material.Limestone, Enum.Material.CrackedLava,
}) do BLOCK[m] = true end
-- materiais que so bloqueiam na floresta comum (nos biomas sao o chao normal)
local DRY = { [Enum.Material.Sand] = true, [Enum.Material.Basalt] = true, [Enum.Material.Slate] = true, [Enum.Material.Sandstone] = true }

local S = {}
local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function ground(x, z)
	local r = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, S.topY, z), Vector3.new(0, -(S.topY + 100), 0), params)
	if r then return r.Position, r.Material, r.Normal, r.Instance end
	return nil
end

local function okGround(x, z, maxSlope, dryOk)
	local pos, mat, nrm, inst = ground(x, z)
	if not pos then return nil, "vazio" end
	if inst ~= Workspace.Terrain then return nil, "nao-terreno" end
	if BLOCK[mat] then return nil, mat.Name end
	if DRY[mat] and not dryOk then return nil, mat.Name end
	if nrm.Y < (maxSlope or 0.8) then return nil, "inclinado" end
	return pos
end

local function wetNear(x, z)
	local offs = { { 6, 0 }, { -6, 0 }, { 0, 6 }, { 0, -6 } }
	for _, o in ipairs(offs) do
		local _, m = ground(x + o[1], z + o[2])
		if m == Enum.Material.Water or m == Enum.Material.Mud then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function freshFolder(name)
	local old = S.root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = S.root
	return f
end

local function setup(opts)
	if opts then for k, v in pairs(opts) do CFG[k] = v end end
	S.b = MapConfig.Bounds
	S.topY = S.b.MaxY + 200
	S.R = MapConfig.Village.Radius - 20 -- 150 = muralha
	S.center = Vector3.new(MapConfig.Village.Center.X, 0, MapConfig.Village.Center.Y)
	local vc = Workspace:FindFirstChild("VillageCenter")
	if vc then
		local p = vc:IsA("BasePart") and vc.Position or vc:GetPivot().Position
		S.center = Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z)
		local r = vc:GetAttribute("Radius")
		if type(r) == "number" then S.R = r end
	end
	S.rng = Random.new(CFG.Seed)
	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Nature")
	if not root then
		root = Instance.new("Folder")
		root.Name = "Nature"
		root.Parent = Workspace
	end
	S.root = root
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { root }
	local assets = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	S.assets = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Nature")
	print(string.format("[Nature] v%d mapa X %d..%d  Z %d..%d  vila r=%d", M.Version, S.b.MinX, S.b.MaxX, S.b.MinZ, S.b.MaxZ, S.R))
end

local function pool(prefixes, mustHave, exclude)
	local list = {}
	if not S.assets then return list end
	for _, a in ipairs(S.assets:GetChildren()) do
		for _, p in ipairs(prefixes) do
			if a.Name:sub(1, #p) == p
				and (not mustHave or a.Name:find(mustHave))
				and not (exclude and a.Name:find(exclude)) then
				table.insert(list, a)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function pick(list) return list[S.rng:NextInteger(1, #list)] end

local function sizeOf(i)
	if i:IsA("Model") then return i:GetExtentsSize() end
	return i.Size
end

local function prep(inst, shadow)
	local parts = inst:IsA("BasePart") and { inst } or inst:GetDescendants()
	for _, d in ipairs(parts) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CastShadow = shadow
		end
	end
end

-- coloca um asset no chao, escalando para uma altura (ou maior dimensao) alvo
local function put(asset, pos, target, parent, useMax, shadow)
	local c = asset:Clone()
	local s = sizeOf(c)
	local ref = useMax and math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z) or s.Y
	local k = target / math.max(ref, 0.01)
	local yaw = S.rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
	if c:IsA("Model") then
		c:ScaleTo(c:GetScale() * k)
		prep(c, shadow)
		c:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0))
		local cf, size = c:GetBoundingBox()
		local delta = Vector3.new(pos.X - cf.X, (pos.Y - 0.3) - (cf.Y - size.Y / 2), pos.Z - cf.Z)
		c:PivotTo(c:GetPivot() + delta)
	else
		c.Size = c.Size * k
		prep(c, shadow)
		c.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y - 0.3 + c.Size.Y / 2, pos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	end
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function nearGate(x, z, dist)
	local off = Vector3.new(x - S.center.X, 0, z - S.center.Z)
	if off.Magnitude < 1 then return false end
	for _, deg in ipairs(CFG.GateAngles) do
		local g = Vector3.new(math.cos(math.rad(deg)), 0, math.sin(math.rad(deg)))
		if off.Unit:Dot(g) > 0.96 and off.Magnitude < S.R + dist then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function naVila(x, z, margem)
	return Vector3.new(x - S.center.X, 0, z - S.center.Z).Magnitude < S.R + margem
end

----------------------------------------------------------------- FLORESTA
function M.Forest()
	if not S.root then setup() end
	if not S.assets then warn("[Nature] ServerStorage/Assets/Nature nao encontrado") return end
	local trees = freshFolder("Trees")
	local details = freshFolder("Details")
	local c, R = S.center, S.R

	local pines = pool({ "tree_pine" }, nil, "dark")
	local pinesDark = pool({ "tree_pine" }, "dark")
	local tallPines = pool({ "tree_pineTall" })
	local broad = pool({ "tree_oak", "tree_default", "tree_fat", "tree_detailed", "tree_blocks", "tree_cone" }, nil, "fall")
	local broadDark = pool({ "tree_oak", "tree_default", "tree_fat", "tree_detailed", "tree_blocks", "tree_cone" }, "dark")
	local fallOnly = pool({ "tree_oak", "tree_default", "tree_fat", "tree_detailed", "tree_blocks" }, "fall")
	local all = pool({ "tree_" })
	if #all == 0 then warn("[Nature] nenhuma arvore (tree_*) em Assets/Nature") return end
	if #pines == 0 then pines = all end
	if #pinesDark == 0 then pinesDark = pines end
	if #broad == 0 then broad = all end
	if #broadDark == 0 then broadDark = broad end
	if #tallPines == 0 then tallPines = pines end
	if #fallOnly == 0 then fallOnly = broad end

	local rej, placed, giants, talls, byBiome = {}, 0, 0, 0, {}
	local n = 0
	local g = CFG.ForestGrid
	local gx = S.b.MinX + 40
	while gx <= S.b.MaxX - 40 do
		local gz = S.b.MinZ + 40
		while gz <= S.b.MaxZ - 40 do
			n = n + 1
			if n % 120 == 0 then task.wait() end
			if placed < CFG.MaxTrees then
				local x = gx + S.rng:NextNumber(-12, 12)
				local z = gz + S.rng:NextNumber(-12, 12)
				local d = Vector3.new(x - c.X, 0, z - c.Z).Magnitude
				local biome = TG.BiomeAt(x, z)
				local ancient = TG.InAncient(x, z)
				local td = TG.TrailDistance(x, z)
				local skip = naVila(x, z, 10) or nearGate(x, z, 60) or td < 9
				local density = 0
				if not skip then
					if biome == "Forest" then
						density = 0.5 + math.noise(x / 280, z / 280, 3.3) * 1.2
						if ancient then density = 0.92 end
						if z > 150 and not ancient then density = density * 0.35 end -- campo aberto ao sul
					elseif biome == "Snow" then density = 0.35
					elseif biome == "Swamp" then density = 0.30
					elseif biome == "Desert" then density = 0.03
					else density = 0 end
					if nearGate(x, z, 160) then density = 0 end
					density = math.clamp(density, 0, 0.95)
				end
				if density > 0 and S.rng:NextNumber() < density then
					local pos, why = okGround(x, z, 0.8, biome ~= "Forest")
					if pos and wetNear(x, z) then pos = nil why = "agua/trilha" end
					if not pos then
						rej[why or "?"] = (rej[why or "?"] or 0) + 1
					else
						local roll = S.rng:NextNumber()
						local conifer = math.noise(x / 400, z / 400, 9.1) > -0.05
						local h, asset
						local giantP = ancient and CFG.AncientGiantChance or CFG.GiantChance
						if biome == "Snow" then
							h = S.rng:NextNumber(24, 50)
							asset = pick(roll < 0.5 and pinesDark or pines)
							if roll < 0.06 then h = S.rng:NextNumber(70, 120) asset = pick(tallPines) end
						elseif biome == "Swamp" then
							h = S.rng:NextNumber(16, 34)
							asset = pick(broadDark)
						elseif biome == "Desert" then
							h = S.rng:NextNumber(12, 22)
							asset = pick(fallOnly)
						elseif d > R + 120 and roll < giantP then
							h = S.rng:NextNumber(110, ancient and 190 or 160)
							if S.rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 then asset = pick(tallPines) else asset = pick(broad) end
							giants = giants + 1
						elseif roll < giantP + CFG.TallChance then
							h = S.rng:NextNumber(50, 85)
							asset = pick(conifer and pines or broad)
							talls = talls + 1
						else
							h = S.rng:NextNumber(22, 42)
							if math.noise(x / 160, z / 160, 5.5) > 0.3 then asset = pick(fallOnly)
							else asset = pick(conifer and pines or broad) end
						end
						if h >= 45 and td < 20 then h = 30 end -- perto da trilha: nada gigante cobrindo o caminho
						local t = put(asset, pos, h, trees, false, h > 30)
						placed = placed + 1
						byBiome[biome] = (byBiome[biome] or 0) + 1
						if h >= 45 then
							local col = Instance.new("Part")
							col.Name = "Trunk"
							col.Anchored = true
							col.CanCollide = true
							col.Transparency = 1
							col.CanQuery = false
							col.CanTouch = false
							col.Size = Vector3.new(h * 0.07, h * 0.4, h * 0.07)
							col.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, h * 0.2, 0))
							col.Parent = t
						end
					end
				end
			end
			gz = gz + g
		end
		gx = gx + g
	end
	print(string.format("[Nature] arvores=%d (gigantes=%d, altas=%d)", placed, giants, talls))
	for k, v in pairs(byBiome) do print("   bioma " .. k .. ": " .. v) end
	for k, v in pairs(rej) do print("   rejeitado por " .. k .. ": " .. v) end

	-- detalhes por bioma
	local flowers, bushes = pool({ "flower" }), pool({ "plant_bush", "bush" })
	local rocksS, rocksL = pool({ "rock_small" }), pool({ "rock_large" })
	local logs, stumps, mush = pool({ "log" }), pool({ "stump" }), pool({ "mushroom" })
	local function spot(list, pos, a, b, useMax, shadow)
		if #list == 0 then return 0 end
		put(pick(list), pos, S.rng:NextNumber(a, b), details, useMax, shadow)
		return 1
	end
	local count, m = 0, 0
	local dg = CFG.DetailGrid
	local dx = S.b.MinX + 40
	while dx <= S.b.MaxX - 40 do
		local dz = S.b.MinZ + 40
		while dz <= S.b.MaxZ - 40 do
			m = m + 1
			if m % 250 == 0 then task.wait() end
			if count < CFG.MaxDetails then
				local x = dx + S.rng:NextNumber(-8, 8)
				local z = dz + S.rng:NextNumber(-8, 8)
				local d = Vector3.new(x - c.X, 0, z - c.Z).Magnitude
				local inVillage = d < R - 8
				local blocked = (inVillage and d < R * 0.7) or (d >= R - 8 and d <= R + 8) or nearGate(x, z, 60)
				if not blocked and S.rng:NextNumber() <= 0.6 then
					local biome = TG.BiomeAt(x, z)
					local pos = okGround(x, z, 0.7, biome ~= "Forest")
					if pos then
						local r = S.rng:NextNumber()
						if inVillage then
							if r < 0.30 and #flowers > 0 then
								for _ = 1, S.rng:NextInteger(5, 9) do
									local fx, fz = x + S.rng:NextNumber(-5, 5), z + S.rng:NextNumber(-5, 5)
									local fp = okGround(fx, fz, 0.7)
									if fp then count = count + spot(flowers, fp, 1.6, 3, false, false) end
								end
							elseif r < 0.55 then count = count + spot(bushes, pos, 4, 8, true, false) end
						elseif biome == "Forest" then
							if r < 0.30 and #flowers > 0 then
								for _ = 1, S.rng:NextInteger(5, 9) do
									local fx, fz = x + S.rng:NextNumber(-5, 5), z + S.rng:NextNumber(-5, 5)
									local fp = okGround(fx, fz, 0.7)
									if fp then count = count + spot(flowers, fp, 1.6, 3, false, false) end
								end

local function lantern(parent, pos, range)
	local l = Instance.new("Part")
	l.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	l.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
	l.Position = pos
	l.Anchored = true
	l.CanCollide = false
	l.CanQuery = false
	l.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 110)
	local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
	pl.Range = range or 26
	pl.Brightness = 1.6
	pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 95)
	pl.Shadows = false
	pl.Parent = l
	l.Parent = parent
end

local function beam(parent, a, b, w, t, color, mat)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Material = mat
	p.Color = color
	p.Size = Vector3.new(w, t, (b - a).Magnitude + 0.15)
	p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b)
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function buildBridge(parent, A, B)
	local dirH = Vector3.new(B.X - A.X, 0, B.Z - A.Z)
	local len = dirH.Magnitude
	local dir = dirH.Unit
	A = A - dir * 5
	B = B + dir * 5
	len = len + 10
	local side = dir:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
	local baseY = math.max(A.Y, B.Y) + 1.6
	local arch = math.clamp(len * 0.06, 1.5, 4)
	local steps = math.max(8, math.floor(len / 5))
	local W = 9
	local wood = Color3.fromRGB(139, 94, 60)
	local dark = Color3.fromRGB(92, 58, 38)
	local nodes = {}
	for i = 0, steps do
		local t = i / steps
		local flat = A:Lerp(B, t)
		nodes[i] = Vector3.new(flat.X, baseY + arch * math.sin(math.pi * t), flat.Z)
	end
	for i = 0, steps - 1 do
		local a, b = nodes[i], nodes[i + 1]
		beam(parent, a, b, W, 1, wood, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
		for k = -1, 1, 2 do
			beam(parent, a + side * k * (W / 2) + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0), b + side * k * (W / 2) + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0), 0.5, 0.5, dark, Enum.Material.Wood)
			beam(parent, a + side * k * (W / 2) + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), b + side * k * (W / 2) + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), 0.4, 0.4, dark, Enum.Material.Wood)
		end
	end
	for i = 0, steps do
		local nd = nodes[i]
		for k = -1, 1, 2 do
			local post = Instance.new("Part")
			post.Anchored = true
			post.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
			post.Color = dark
			post.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 3.4, 0.8)
			post.Position = nd + side * k * (W / 2) + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			post.Parent = parent
		end
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			local gp = ground(nd.X, nd.Z)
			local bottom = (gp and gp.Y or nd.Y - 10) - 6
			local h = nd.Y - bottom
			local pil = Instance.new("Part")
			pil.Anchored = true
			pil.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
			pil.Color = dark
			pil.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, h, 1.6)
			pil.Position = Vector3.new(nd.X, bottom + h / 2, nd.Z) + side * (W / 2 - 1)
			pil.Parent = parent
			local pil2 = pil:Clone()
			pil2.Position = Vector3.new(nd.X, bottom + h / 2, nd.Z) - side * (W / 2 - 1)
			pil2.Parent = parent
		end
	end
	for _, e in ipairs({ 0, steps }) do
		local nd = nodes[e]
		for k = -1, 1, 2 do
			lantern(parent, nd + side * k * (W / 2) + Vector3.new(0, 4.6, 0), 28)
		end
	end
end

local function riverDist(x, z)
	local best = math.huge
	for _, r in ipairs(MapConfig.Rivers) do
		best = math.min(best, math.abs(x - TG.RiverX(z, r)))
	end
	return best
end

function M.Bridges()
	if not S.root then setup() end
	local f = freshFolder("Bridges")
	local waters, n = {}, 0
	local x = S.b.MinX + 40
	while x <= S.b.MaxX - 40 do
		local z = S.b.MinZ + 40
		while z <= S.b.MaxZ - 40 do
			n = n + 1
			if n % 300 == 0 then task.wait() end
			if riverDist(x, z) < 14 then -- so rios (lagos nao recebem ponte)
				local _, mat = ground(x, z)
				if mat == Enum.Material.Water then table.insert(waters, Vector3.new(x, 0, z)) end
			end
			z = z + 24
		end
		x = x + 24
	end
	print("[Nature] pontos de agua (rios): " .. #waters)
	for i = #waters, 2, -1 do
		local j = S.rng:NextInteger(1, i)
		waters[i], waters[j] = waters[j], waters[i]
	end
	local built, tries = {}, 0
	for _, w in ipairs(waters) do
		if #built < CFG.MaxBridges then
			tries = tries + 1
			if tries % 20 == 0 then task.wait() end
			local tooClose = (Vector3.new(w.X, 0, w.Z) - S.center).Magnitude < S.R + 40
			for _, b in ipairs(built) do if (b - w).Magnitude < 170 then tooClose = true end end
			if not tooClose then
				local best
				for deg = 0, 165, 15 do
					local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(math.rad(deg)), 0, math.sin(math.rad(deg)))
					local samples = {}
					for k = -12, 12 do
						local p, mt, nrm = ground(w.X + dir.X * k * 4, w.Z + dir.Z * k * 4)
						samples[k] = { p = p, water = (mt == Enum.Material.Water), up = nrm and nrm.Y or 0 }
					end
					if samples[0].water then
						local lo, hi = 0, 0
						while samples[lo - 1] and samples[lo - 1].water do lo = lo - 1 end
						while samples[hi + 1] and samples[hi + 1].water do hi = hi + 1 end
						local a, b = samples[lo - 1], samples[hi + 1]
						if a and b and a.p and b.p and a.up > 0.7 and b.up > 0.7 and math.abs(a.p.Y - b.p.Y) < 8 then
							local L = (b.p - a.p).Magnitude
							if L > 12 and L < 70 and (not best or L < best.L) then
								best = { L = L, A = a.p, B = b.p }
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if best then
					buildBridge(f, best.A, best.B)
					table.insert(built, w)
					print(string.format("[Nature] ponte em %d, %d (vao %.0f studs)", best.A.X, best.A.Z, best.L))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #built == 0 then warn("[Nature] nenhuma ponte possivel; ajuste L (12-70) no codigo") end
end

local function removeOldVillage()
	local n = 0
	for _, f in { workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") and workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("Village"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Stalls"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") and workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("Markers") } do

		end

function M.Run(opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		warn("[Rebuild] bloqueado: so roda no Studio em modo Edit (nunca durante o jogo).")
		return
	end
	if workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate") then
		warn("[Rebuild] AVISO: existe um Baseplate no Workspace. Apague-o (o terreno agora tem 2400x2400 studs).")
	end
	local src = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("MapGen")
	local gen = src:Clone() -- cópia nova = sem cache, sempre o código atual do Rojo
	gen.Name = "MapGen_Run"
	gen.Parent = ServerStorage

	local cfg = require(gen.MapConfig)
	local tg = require(gen.TerrainGen)
	if cfg.Version ~= 3 or tg.Version ~= 3 then
		warn("[Rebuild] MapConfig/TerrainGen DESATUALIZADOS no Studio. Confira o Rojo (versões: " .. tostring(cfg.Version) .. "/" .. tostring(tg.Version) .. ")")
		gen:Destroy()
		return
	end

	step("limpeza", removeOldVillage)
	local okBase = step("terreno (BuildBase)", function()
		require(gen.BuildBase).Run({ terrain = opts.terrain })
	end)
	if okBase then
		step("vila (VillageBuilder)", function()
			local vb = SSS:FindFirstChild("VillageBuilder", true)
			assert(vb, "VillageBuilder não encontrado em ServerScriptService")
			require(vb:Clone()).Build()
		end)
		step("natureza (BuildNature)", function()
			require(gen.BuildNature).Run()
		end)
	end
	gen:Destroy()
	pcall(function() game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService"):SetWaypoint("Rebuild All") end)
	print("[Rebuild] fim. Salve o place (Ctrl+S).")
end

return M
